query: I went to the new coffee shop downtown this morning, their lavender honey latte is so creamy and not too sweet, I even got a free little lemon shortbread cookie with my order. On my way home I stopped by the community garden, the tomato plants I planted last month are already sprouting tiny green tomatoes, I’m so excited to pick them when they ripen. My cat also figured out how to open the kitchen cabinet last night, he dragged out a bag of treats and ate half of it before I caught him, I had to move all the snacks to a higher shelf after that. Anyway, I’m having issues with my phone service right now, I can’t get any mobile data or make calls at all. I already checked and airplane mode is turned on, my APN settings seem to be messed up, I got a notice the other day that my line is suspended because I have an overdue bill and my contract just ended, also my SIM card is locked and it’s asking for a PIN I can’t remember right now.
